payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the features were used in a machine learning model to detect IRA trolls based on textual analysis.

claims.text: The features used were text-based features for a machine learning model to detect IRA trolls.
The model utilized a rich set of textual features, including emotional and sentiment analysis, to identify IRA trolls.
The model employed Logistic Regression as the classifier for training on the textual features extracted from tweets.
